gate_ab.method: One complete gate run per configuration on the same host, same source and prebuilt recomp binary; the script ran cargo build before its fixture groups. These are single paired samples, not a repeated median.
limitations: Per-group wall markers include fixture generation, compile, execution and manifest checks.
time -lp maximum resident size is not a sum of concurrent worker RSS; aggregate worker memory was not measured.
Zero swaps were reported in both runs. No claim is made that all ten CPUs were saturated for the full gate.
This measures independent synthetic fixture throughput, not the serial discovery or LLVM emission of a commercial ROM.

exact_leafgreen_ldrh_encoding_fixture.inference: LDRH r1,[r4,#0] based on encoding fields; this fixture validates local AOT behavior and does not establish execution of LeafGreen.

leafgreen_compile_attempt.command: gba-recomp compile --rom 'roms/Pokemon - Leaf Green Version (U) (V1.1).gba' --out target/leafgreen-after-spec042-20261014-O2 --opt O2 --steps 100
leafgreen_compile_attempt.result: bx_target_unresolved at 0x08000B6A: r0 is not statically bounded

static_bytes.0x08000B50: 0xD009 BNE; both successors remain possible while the loaded byte is Unknown
static_bytes.0x08000B52: 0x4A07 LDR r2,[pc,#0x1C]; literal statically resolves to 0x04000208

leafgreen_compile_attempt.interpretation: LDRB r0 is followed by CMP r0,#0, so discovery keeps both BNE successors. On the fallthrough path the LDR literal sets r2 to the statically inferred address 0x04000208 and STRH writes there; the current abstract memory policy conservatively clears its RAM stack shadow for a write outside supported physical RAM. The later LDRH destination is overwritten by POP {r0}; because the shadow was cleared on this path, POP {r0} is Unknown and the final BX cannot be closed. This is static analyzer behavior and encoding/address inference, not a guest execution trace.

limitations: LeafGreen was not packaged or executed; REA did not provide a decompilation session for this .gba artifact.
Only Darwin arm64 was tested; Linux x86-64 remains pending.
Dynamic memory operations in these new fixtures support physical EWRAM/IWRAM only; MMIO faults explicitly.
CPU saturation and aggregate concurrent worker RSS were not established by this measurement.
